card.name: Induced vomiting and intentional overdose wording
card.fires_on: Words like induced, intentional, intentionally, or the verb after 'emesis' in overdosage sections. They describe making a patient vomit or deliberate ingestion.

modes.label: Inducing vomiting
modes.description: The word 'is' or 'induced' right after emesis or vomiting in overdose treatment advice.

modes.label: Intentional overdose
modes.description: Words like intentional or intentionally describing deliberate overdose or self-harm.
modes.example: There is no experience with<< intentional>> overdosage.

card.plain: It marks overdose passages that talk about making someone vomit or taking a drug on purpose.
